title: Tensor pullback preserves a map invertible on an open
statement: theorem tensorPullback_map_over_isIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) {M N : Y.Modules} (h : M ⟶ N) (hh : IsIso (h.over U)) : IsIso (((tensorPullback f).map h).over (f ⁻¹ᵁ U))

source.place: Lemma 6.26.4, natural stalk formula, and stalk detection of isomorphisms

proof.text: Convert the over isomorphism to an isomorphism on the open subscheme using overFunctorEquiv. At a point of the inverse image open, restrictStalkNatIso identifies its map with an invertible ambient stalk map.

Apply the natural restricted tensor-pullback stalk comparison. Base change of the source linear equivalence is a linear equivalence, so conjugation by the two stalk comparisons proves bijectivity of the pulled-back stalk map.
Apply isIso_of_bijective_stalkLinearMap on the open subscheme, then reflect the isomorphism through overEquiv to return to the over category.
